query_text: How do I configure SAML 2.0 clock skew tolerance in CloudAuth?
expected_answer: Set clock skew tolerance >= 300 seconds under Security Settings.

query_text: What error code is returned when an SSO bearer token expires?
expected_answer: ERR_TOKEN_EXPIRED (Code 4012).

query_text: How do I configure Azure AD callback URL?
expected_answer: Set callback URL to https://auth.enterprise.io/login/callback.

query_text: What is the maximum token lifetime in CloudAuth?
expected_answer: Maximum access token lifetime is 3600 seconds (1 hour).

query_text: How to enable MFA enforcement across all enterprise tenants?
expected_answer: Enable Global MFA Toggle in IAM Security Policies.

query_text: What algorithm is used for signing OAuth JWT tokens?
expected_answer: RS256 with 2048-bit RSA keys.

query_text: How to revoke compromised user sessions immediately?
expected_answer: Invoke /api/v1/auth/revoke-sessions endpoint with user ID.

query_text: What is the default session timeout for idle portal users?
expected_answer: Default idle timeout is 15 minutes.

query_text: Can external contractors use social Google logins?
expected_answer: Only if contractor domain whitelisting is active.

query_text: What is the root cause of error KE-AUTH-88?
expected_answer: Expired SAML signing certificate on Identity Provider.

query_text: What is the default minimum connection pool size in DataStore?
expected_answer: Minimum connection pool size is 10 connections.

query_text: What is the maximum connection pool limit under peak traffic?
expected_answer: Maximum connection pool limit is 100 connections.

query_text: Which error code indicates connection pool timeout?
expected_answer: ERR_CONN_TIMEOUT (Code 5003).

query_text: How to prevent lock escalation during heavy batch jobs?
expected_answer: Route batch jobs to read replicas and tune lock timeout.

query_text: What is the automated idle connection reap threshold?
expected_answer: Idle connections are reaped automatically after 60 seconds.

query_text: What is the recovery time objective (RTO) for database failover?
expected_answer: RTO is guaranteed at less than 2 minutes.

query_text: What is the target recovery point objective (RPO)?
expected_answer: RPO is guaranteed at less than 15 seconds.

query_text: What storage engine is used for high write-throughput tables?
expected_answer: LSM-Tree storage engine with NVMe SSD caching.

query_text: How often are automated automated full database snapshots taken?
expected_answer: Daily at 02:00 UTC with continuous WAL archiving.

query_text: What is the recommended fix for error KE-PG-CONN-409?
expected_answer: Scale PgBouncer pooler and kill idle connections.

query_text: What is the default sliding-window rate limit per API key?
expected_answer: 1,000 requests per minute.

query_text: What HTTP error code is returned upon rate limit breach?
expected_answer: HTTP 429 (ERR_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED).

query_text: Can Enterprise customers request quota increase up to 10,000 req/min?
expected_answer: Yes, via customer configuration tier upgrade.

query_text: What MTU size is required across VPC peering links?
expected_answer: Standard MTU 1500 bytes (clamp MSS to 1460 bytes).

query_text: What causes HTTP 504 timeouts on checkout API across VPCs?
expected_answer: MTU mismatch packet fragmentation black hole.

query_text: What TLS version is enforced on API Gateway entry points?
expected_answer: TLS 1.3 only (TLS 1.0 and 1.1 are deprecated).

query_text: How to configure custom domain routing on API Gateway?
expected_answer: Add CNAME record pointing to edge.api.enterprise.io.

query_text: What header contains the unique request trace ID?
expected_answer: X-Request-Trace-ID.

query_text: What is the maximum allowed payload size for POST requests?
expected_answer: 10 Megabytes (MB).

query_text: How to enable CORS headers for trusted frontend domains?
expected_answer: Configure Allowed-Origins in gateway routing policy.

query_text: What are the standard payment terms for Enterprise invoices?
expected_answer: Net 30 days from invoice date.

query_text: Where is vendor tax identification listed on invoices?
expected_answer: In the invoice header under TAX ID: US-948271049.

query_text: What sales tax percentage applies to California transactions?
expected_answer: 8.5% standard state sales tax.

query_text: How are overage compute hours calculated at month end?
expected_answer: Rounded up to the nearest minute and billed at $0.04/vCPU-hr.

query_text: Can invoices be exported in automated structured JSON format?
expected_answer: Yes, via the /api/v1/invoices/export endpoint.

query_text: What happens if an account invoice remains unpaid after 60 days?
expected_answer: Account enters soft-suspension status.

query_text: How to apply promotional discount codes to annual contracts?
expected_answer: Apply coupon code in the billing subscription portal.

query_text: Which credit cards are accepted for automatic recurring billing?
expected_answer: Visa, MasterCard, and American Express.

query_text: How can customers update their billing contact email address?
expected_answer: Under Organization Settings -> Billing Contacts tab.

query_text: What is the currency code for international Euro invoices?
expected_answer: EUR.

query_text: How frequently must production API keys and secrets be rotated?
expected_answer: At least every 90 days according to security compliance.

query_text: What encryption cipher is used for protecting data at rest?
expected_answer: AES-256 GCM with KMS customer-managed keys.

query_text: What is the mandatory VPN requirement for remote employees?
expected_answer: Corporate Zero-Trust VPN with hardware MFA tokens.

query_text: How often are automated TLS certificates renewed?
expected_answer: Every 60 days via Let's Encrypt / Cert-Manager.

query_text: What is the target p99 latency for checkout microservices?
expected_answer: Maximum 250ms at p99 latency.

query_text: How is PII data sanitized prior to analytics ingestion?
expected_answer: Masked via SHA-256 pseudonymization and tokenization.

query_text: What is the protocol for reporting suspected data breaches?
expected_answer: Immediate page to SecOps within 15 minutes.

query_text: Are production SSH bastion keys shared across teams?
expected_answer: Strictly prohibited; individual certificate-based SSH only.

query_text: What is the platform uptime SLA commitment for enterprise?
expected_answer: 99.99% monthly availability SLA.

query_text: Where are immutable audit logs stored?
expected_answer: In write-once-read-many (WORM) S3 Glacier buckets.
